key_decisions.decision: Introduces Ezra naturally while preserving the start of his ancestral chain rather than implying all links are immediate generations.
Keeps the scribe’s expertise, the instruction’s giver, and the recurring hand image.
Preserves both exact dates and the good hand image; does not collapse the departure stages with 8:31.
Keeps the heart and the study–practice–teaching sequence central to the verse.
Retains the royal title and marks the Aramaic document opening; the elliptical greeting is noted.
Retains each ceiling, every ancient unit, and the exceptional unlimited salt provision.
Retains the specified jurisdiction and the duty to teach, without extending the decree beyond its stated group.
Keeps all coercive penalties explicit; notes uncertainty in the banishment term.
